$description: Appearance-invariant base tokens and press-scale override for the Solid Glass theme.

designMd.overview: Solid Glass (`deeplethe/solid-glass`, MIT): panes of smoky translucent glass with top-edge light rims, hairline glass borders, and ambient drop shadows (`state.press-scale: 1`).
designMd.elevation: Layered glass elevation: surfaces combine translucent fills (`alpha < 1` over page grounds), top-edge inset highlights, `--glass-edge` borders, soft shadows, and backdrop blur (`glass`, `menu`, `modal`, `tooltip`, `inverse`).
dos: Keep press interactions flat (`state.press-scale: 1`); pressed panes deepen and drop shadow rather than shrinking.
Keep gradient stops `transparent` on translucent `background` finishes so alpha is not doubled by the canvas.
donts: Do not stack opaque fills behind translucent glass gradients; keep the `background` layer `transparent` when the gradient carries the fill.

radius.$description: Solid Glass layered corner radius scale (11px control, 14px container, 20px modal) referenced by semantic shape roles.

control.$description: Corner radius for in-page controls, fields, rows, chips, badges, wells, color areas, and kbd.

container.$description: Corner radius for cards, menus, popovers, tooltips, list panels, toasts, and frames.

modal.$description: Corner radius for dialogs, sheets, and drawers.

color.$description: Appearance-invariant C-layer color roles shared by light and dark modes.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop scrim behind modals and sheets (50% black).

media.$description: Ground behind photographs and videos; invariant across appearances.

on-media.$description: White ink over photographs and dark media surfaces; invariant across appearances.

state.$description: Interaction state opacities and press scale.

press-scale.$description: Scale factor applied while pressed (1 disables press shrinking for Solid Glass panes).
